title: Near-Optimal Deterministic Exact-Value Complexity for Smooth Convex Optimization
summary: We study the deterministic oracle complexity of smooth convex optimization when the algorithm receives only exact function values. The objective is a globally $β$-smooth convex function, all queries and the final output are restricted to the Euclidean ball of radius $R$, and the unique minimizer lies in the ball of radius $R/2$. We establish an upper bound of $O(d\sqrt{βR^2/ε})$ using coordinate finite differences together with an error-robust accelerated projected method.
